integrity: The proof is self-contained and separates infinite reasoning from finite computation. The packaged checker simulates the propagation rule independently of the closed-form classifier and verifies all coefficients in the stated finite range. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The all-parameter theorem is proved analytically. Exhaustive computation checks only \(3\le n\le8\) and \(1\le k\le n\). The 2019 publisher PDF could not be obtained as a local complete copy because direct retrieval required interactive verification; the indexed publisher extraction nevertheless exposes the standard crown definition, its stated lower-bound theorem, proof text, and algorithm output. The contradiction statement is restricted to the standard generalized \(k\)-power rule used in the theorem.
title: Exact generalized power-domination profile of crown graphs
